# Contributing

Thank you for taking the time to contribute. Please read the guidelines below before opening an issue or making changes.

## Reporting issues

- Search existing issues before opening a new one to avoid duplicates.
- Use the appropriate issue template (bug report or feature request).
- Provide as much detail as possible, including steps to reproduce and environment information.

## Branching

- Branch from `main` for all changes.
- Use descriptive branch names, e.g. `fix/sample-sheet-parsing` or `feat/add-multiqc-step`.
- Keep branches short-lived and focused on a single change.

## Making changes

- Make small, focused commits with clear messages.
- Follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) style where possible:
  - `fix: correct sample name parsing`
  - `feat: add FastQC step to QC workflow`
  - `docs: update usage instructions`
- Do not commit sensitive data, credentials, or large binary files.

## Code style

- Follow conventions already present in the codebase.
- Keep pipeline logic and configuration clearly separated.
- Comment non-obvious decisions in code or workflow files.

## Questions

If you are unsure about something, open a discussion or contact the BABS team before starting work.

## References

- [GitHub: Setting guidelines for repository contributors](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/setting-up-your-project-for-healthy-contributions/setting-guidelines-for-repository-contributors)
